items.title: Human thermal signature as true body silhouette (depth carve) not a blob
items.acceptance: thermal human mask follows the person's real outline from the depth image (head/torso/limbs), leaves background cold, and the display overlay is a crisp silhouette not a Gaussian ellipse
items.notes: Added _carve_person_from_depth in utils/fire_sensors/humans_thermal.py: within the projected bbox, threshold depth to a band around the person's distance, morphological open/close, keep the connected component nearest the projected centre, distance-transform for a soft core->edge ramp. Falls back to the old ellipse blob only when depth is unavailable/occluded. Tightened the display bloom (glow_ksize 25->7, gain 0.9->0.35) so it no longer smears the outline back into a blob. Verified with scripts/test_human_thermal.py: silhouette/cluster area ratio 1.00, arm-gap columns stay cold.

items.title: Fix thermal temperature field: stop using RGB luma as temperature
items.acceptance: compose_thermal returns a physical temperature map (ambient where no heat, ~ambient+25 for a person, ~600 for fire) independent of RGB luma; display uses FLIR-style AGC with fixed low anchor + adaptive high anchor (min ambient+40) so warm bodies are visible without a fire
items.notes: Old code added (luma-0.5)*35 into the returned temperature and hard-pinned the display stretch at 600C, so the thermal map was a recoloured RGB and everything but fire was crushed. Rewrote compose_thermal in utils/fire_sensors/voxel_render.py: temperature = ambient + max(voxel_excess, flame_excess); luma now only a faint display-only texture that fades on hot pixels. Verified with scripts/test_human_thermal.py (no-fire map flat at ambient; fire peak 620C).

items.title: Fix human thermal signature never rendering (camera_K type mismatch)
items.acceptance: humans painted into thermal image + temperature map when camera_K is the argparse.Namespace returned by get_camera_K; failure no longer swallowed silently
items.notes: Root cause: humans_thermal.py indexed camera_K[0,0] but get_camera_K returns a Namespace (.fx/.fy/.cx/.cy), raising TypeError that fire_pipeline swallowed via bare except: pass, so humans never appeared in IR (visible in Depth panel but absent in Thermal panel of the teleop screenshot). Added _unpack_intrinsics() supporting both matrix and attribute forms; surfaced the overlay error once instead of silently passing. Verified with scripts/test_human_thermal.py (painted fraction 0.124, peak temp 50C).

items.title: Fix depth_use_clean wiping flame/smoke from fire render/dashboard
items.acceptance: RGB/thermal ray-march uses pristine geometric depth independent of depth_use_clean; flame_px identical for 0 and 1 and stable across frames
items.notes: Root cause: volumetric_composite terminates rays at observations['depth']; smoke-degraded depth clipped rays before the fire. Fix in utils/fire_pipeline.step_fire_observation: stash pristine depth as observations['_fire_clean_depth_raw'] and always render against it; flag now only controls mapping write-back. Verified on real timeline 83679a07b632 (flame_px 0.506 in all cases vs 0.011/oscillating before). Updated arguments.py help + docs/main_usage.md. Temp debug scripts removed.
